units.source_text: 翌日，六日早晨，在《东京日日新闻》的照拂下，川岛博士从东京前来给名人诊病。

en.t: The next morning, the sixth, under the auspices of the Tokyo Nichinichi Shimbun, Dr. Kawashima came from Tokyo to examine the Master.

units.source_text: 据他说，病名叫主动脉瓣关闭不全症。

en.t: According to him, the illness was called aortic valve insufficiency.
